scripts.dev: bun run scripts/ensure-dev-vars.ts && bun run build && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: bun test files.test.ts src/shared/slug.test.ts src/worker/http.test.ts src/worker/session.test.ts src/worker/limits.test.ts src/worker/files.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
